messages:
maria: FYI ran nightly bench against main after the fused-attn kernel change. p50/p90 fine but p99 jumped ~45% on 2048-token tails. attaching quick summary below. :eyes:

sam: Can you paste the exact job config? batch sizes, seq len distribution, quant settings?

maria: job: nightly/attn-coverage, config: --seq-dist=prod-trace-2025.csv --batch=8 --beam=1 --quant=none. run id 2025-11-03-03. logs attached (snippet).

ryan: paste of the latency percentiles from the run: `p50=38ms p90=72ms p95=95ms p99=213ms p999=420ms`

ellie: interesting. did we run against fused-attn with deterministic KV cache? last PR disabled the stable-kv flag for performance. that can introduce variance.

maria: stable-kv was off. but even before PR the p99 was ~145ms. this is a clear regression.

sam: any differences in HW or driver versions?

maria: same AMI and driver. CUDA 12.1, cuDNN pinned.

ryan: I reran a quick A/B with the exact commit before the fused change and with current main. A: commit abc123 (before) p99=148ms. B: main p99=210ms. So regression lands with merge.

kate: did the PR also change scheduler/kernel selection heuristics? last week we adjusted kernel fallback order for short heads.

ellie: yes the PR touched kernel picker heuristics + added an opt for fused epilogue. could be a codepath that trips for long seqs.

maria: quick diff I ran points to runtime/kernel_selector.cpp lines 312-347. the new condition `prefer_fused_for_seq` is true for seq >= 1024; maybe we accidentally prefer a slower fused variant for tail lengths.

sam: we should run a microbench that isolates the attention shards. please run the unit microbench with:
```
./bench/attn_micro --model=resnet-llm --seq=2048 --batch=1 --iters=1000 --kernel=all
```
and capture per-kernel p99.

ryan: running that now. quick output: `fused_attn_p99=195ms unfused_attn_p99=120ms other=...` Looks like fused is slower at long seqs on this hw.

ellie: that suggests the fallback logic flipped preference incorrectly. we need to update the selector to use measured latency model, not only heuristics. I can draft a patch to consult lightweight microbench results cached per instance type.

maria: also need to check correctness. small numerical diffs are allowed, but we saw some sequences where logits diverged > 1e-2 after quant path. Not sure if related.

sam: add a regression test comparing output logits of fused vs unfused for a few seeds. if diffs > 1e-3 fail. Make it part of the nightly acceptance.

kate: infra-bot just posted a deploy event around the time of the regression: `infra-bot: deploy main -> prod at 2025-11-03T02:58:10Z by ci-pipeline`.

ryan: ok plan: 1) bisect commits between abc123..main to find exact commit. 2) run microbench per commit to confirm change in kernel perf. 3) add unit that asserts performance heuristic for seq>=1024 picks unfused if measured p99 of fused > unfused by 20%. 4) add logits equality check for quant/epilogue combos.

ellie: agreed. I'll own the selector patch and perf unit. maria can do the bisect and open a regression PR with trace. sam will add the nightly tests.

maria: starting bisect now, will upload results to the thread. thanks. :+1:
